title: FiLM versus Mirror feature conditioning
hypothesis: On held-out examples for eight context-specific feature transforms generated by shared Givens rotations, a per-context eight-angle Mirror transform attains lower normalized prediction error than FiLM and rank-one residual controls at lower serialized inference bytes; when target transforms leave the rotation family, private residual state is necessary.
physical_object: One shared frozen 16-dimensional nonlinear feature block (16→16→16 ReLU MLP), common to all contexts and methods.
mirror_coordinate: Eight FP32 Givens angles per context, one for each fixed adjacent feature pair; rotation applied to the shared feature vector.
logical_multiplicity: Eight context-conditioned logical feature transforms over one shared physical feature block.
controls: FiLM: context-specific diagonal scale and bias (32 scalars/context)
rank-one affine residual: shared identity plus u_c v_c^T and bias (33 scalars/context)
independent full 16x16 affine transform/context upper control

development.selection_metric: mean held-out NRMSE by transform-mixture alpha; select no hyperparameters using fresh seeds; fixed Adam and steps across controls.

task.alpha_meaning: alpha=1 is exactly in the fixed Givens family; alpha=0 includes an independent dense private target residual; intermediate values linearly mix these function targets. All alpha values share generated worlds but are reported separately.

storage.format: deterministic NPZ containing FP16 inference tensors, UTF-8 JSON metadata, and all per-context codes/coefficients; serialize each method independently with equal metadata fields.

compute.active_compute_proxy: measured multiply-add and elementwise operation count from explicit method formulas; report bytes and per-example modulation ops.

success_gate: Development only: at alpha=1, Mirror mean NRMSE <=0.02 and at least 10x lower than FiLM and rank-one residual; actual serialized bytes <=0.75x FiLM and <=0.10x independent affine; Mirror eager CPU throughput >=0.80x FiLM. Gate must hold in both development seeds. This only qualifies for fresh confirmation, not a capacity claim.
failure_gate: FAIL Mirror-specific screen if either development seed misses the alpha=1 quality/byte/runtime gate, or if rank-one residual matches Mirror within 5% NRMSE at byte ratio <=1.10. Retain alpha<1 and Mirror+residual as diagnostics.
boundaries: This is a synthetic mechanism screen; no natural-task or Transformer quality claim.
Fixed-update comparisons are learning-efficiency evidence only.
alpha=1 is aligned to the Mirror basis; results do not establish arbitrary-function capacity.
No fresh/audit results may be opened or used to tune.
If the independent affine upper control cannot fit its own generating target, mark NOT ESTABLISHED.
